title: Build a bounded QR symbol
responsibility: Encodes short printable ASCII text as QR modules and a drawing path.

inputs.name: qrSymbol.text
inputs.description: The text passed to the QR encoder. Its JavaScript string length must be at most 320 and it must match /^[!-~]+$/ (one or more characters from ! through ~); results wider than 77 modules are refused.

outputs.name: qrLimits
outputs.description: The shared limits used by QR encoding and drawing: maxBytes is 320, the quiet margin is 4 modules, the maximum width is 77 modules, and error correction is level M.

outputs.name: qrSymbol
outputs.description: The encoded symbol returned for drawing: size is the number of modules per side, quiet is the 4-module margin, and path contains closed one-module-high boxes for horizontal dark runs offset by that margin. Symbols wider than 77 modules are refused.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws Error('This cannot be shown as a QR code.') when the input fails the character or length check or the encoded symbol exceeds 77 modules; errors from qrcode.create propagate.
